 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Jasmeet Singh
 Order
% 17.02.2023 Crl.M.A. 4351/2023-Ex.
Allowed subject to all just exceptions.

This is a petition filed seeking speedy trial and expeditious disposal of the cases being FIR No. 245/2018 registered at PS Pulprehlad under Section 498A IPC titled State vs. Anil Kumar and FIR No.
7876/2018 titled Karuna vs. Anil Kumar under Domestic Violence Act.
It is always the endeavour of the Courts in the country to ensure speedy trial and early disposal of cases and no specific directions are required in this regard.

However, since it is stated that the promotion of the petitioner is stalled due to the pendency of the two cases mentioned above, the concerned Court shall ensure that no unnecessary adjournments are given in the said cases.
With these directions, the petition is disposed of.
